routeFamily.routesStillUsingSpecializedFallback: None. All 3 webdav routes are FROZEN to webdavConfigV2; render-runtime.js switch fallback throws Error for these routes.

uniqueProductionRenderer.dispatchEntry: renderRoute() checks window.ReaderD2SettingsSyncRenderers.renderD2Route(route, data, appState) before falling to switch-case fallback; renderD2Route() looks up INTEGRATION_MAP['webdav-config'] = 'webdavConfigV2'

r2aInstrumentation.stageDefinition: R2a = stable control identity: every operable control has 5 data-* attributes (data-entity-key, data-control-key, data-control-id, data-ui-event, data-settings-key). No ordinal, CSS selector, display text, or array position used as stable identity.

identityStampingStrategy.switch: stamped on <span class='fd-settings-switch' role='switch'> (the actual toggle element)
identityStampingStrategy.input: stamped on <input> element (the actual input element; receives aria-invalid + aria-describedby on validation error)
identityStampingStrategy.stepper: stamped on each <button> (minus / plus); container <span> does NOT stamp identity, only has aria-label on group
identityStampingStrategy.select: stamped on <article> row (click opens options list); role='button' + aria-haspopup='listbox' + aria-expanded='false' + tabindex='0'
identityStampingStrategy.sectionAction: stamped on <button> in section.actions (测试网络连通性 / 保存配置)
identityStampingStrategy.bottomAction: stamped on <button> in page.actions (重试连接 / 修改配置 / 清除配置 in webdav-error)
identityStampingStrategy.dialogButton: stamped on <button> in dialog (confirm/cancel/重试/知道了/关闭)
identityStampingStrategy.linkRow: stamped on <article> for webdav-error link rows with settingsKey (可能原因 + 建议操作)

failClosedGuard.rule: lookup keyed by route::settingsKey; accepts both r2.0-subcontrol and a3-action sources; returns empty attrs if not found

r2bRealInteraction.stageDefinition: R2b = real interaction: state owner + reducer + dispatch + subscribe + persist + UiEvent wiring + 3 async flows + focus return + ARIA + input validation. webdav-config controls actually work end-to-end.

stateDomains.values: { serverUrl, account, password, syncDir, sslVerify, connectTimeout, wifiOnly, autoSync }; persisted to localStorage on change
stateDomains.inputErrors: transient map of settingsKey → { message }; cleared on SET_INPUT for that field or cleared entirely on CLEAR_SUCCESS
stateDomains.test: transient { open, status, error, result }; status ∈ idle/confirm/loading/success/failed
stateDomains.save: transient { open, status, error }; status ∈ idle/confirm/loading/success/failed
stateDomains.clear: transient { open, status, error }; status ∈ idle/confirm/loading/success/failed

persistence.strategy: d2Set on SET_INPUT / TOGGLE_SWITCH / STEP_TIMEOUT / SELECT_AUTO_SYNC / CLEAR_SUCCESS (writes values object); other state is transient

stateOwner.duplicateClickGuard: TEST_START / SAVE_START / CLEAR_START reducers return same state reference when status !== 'confirm'; listeners are not notified
stateOwner.staleAsyncResultGuard: TEST_SUCCESS / TEST_FAILED, SAVE_SUCCESS / SAVE_FAILED, CLEAR_SUCCESS / CLEAR_FAILED reducers return same state reference when status !== 'loading'; stale async results are discarded
stateOwner.mutualExclusionGuard: TEST_CONFIRM_OPEN / SAVE_CONFIRM_OPEN / CLEAR_CONFIRM_OPEN return same state reference when another dialog is already open
stateOwner.loadingCloseGuard: TEST_CONFIRM_CLOSE / SAVE_CONFIRM_CLOSE / CLEAR_CONFIRM_CLOSE return same state reference when status === 'loading' (cannot close dialog during loading)
stateOwner.clearSuccessSideEffect: CLEAR_SUCCESS resets values to D2_WEBDAV_CONFIG_DEFAULTS and clears inputErrors

uiEventWiring.input: data-ui-event='input.change' → SET_INPUT action (serverUrl / account / password / syncDir)
uiEventWiring.inputValidate: INPUT_VALIDATE action triggered on form submission attempts (before TEST_CONFIRM_OPEN / SAVE_CONFIRM_OPEN)
uiEventWiring.select: data-ui-event='dropdown.option.select' → SELECT_AUTO_SYNC action (only valid options accepted)
uiEventWiring.testConnection: data-ui-event='webdav-test.confirm' → TEST_CONFIRM_OPEN action → TEST_START → d2ExecuteWebdavTest() → TEST_SUCCESS/TEST_FAILED
uiEventWiring.saveConfig: data-ui-event='webdav-save.confirm' → SAVE_CONFIRM_OPEN action → SAVE_START → d2ExecuteWebdavSave() → SAVE_SUCCESS/SAVE_FAILED
uiEventWiring.clearConfig: data-ui-event='webdav-clear.confirm' → CLEAR_CONFIRM_OPEN action → CLEAR_START → d2ExecuteWebdavClear() → CLEAR_SUCCESS/SAVE_FAILED

asyncFlowHelpers.signature: options = { simulateResult: 'success'|'failed', delay: ms, error: string, result: { latencyMs, permission, dirExists } }
asyncFlowHelpers.behavior: dispatch TEST_START → setTimeout(delay) → dispatch TEST_SUCCESS or TEST_FAILED → resolve(result)

asyncFlowHelpers.signature: options = { simulateResult: 'success'|'failed', delay: ms, error: string }
asyncFlowHelpers.behavior: dispatch SAVE_START → setTimeout(delay) → dispatch SAVE_SUCCESS or SAVE_FAILED → resolve(result)

asyncFlowHelpers.signature: options = { simulateResult: 'success'|'failed', delay: ms, error: string }
asyncFlowHelpers.behavior: dispatch CLEAR_START → setTimeout(delay) → dispatch CLEAR_SUCCESS or CLEAR_FAILED → resolve(result); CLEAR_SUCCESS resets values to defaults
asyncFlowHelpers.sideEffectOnSuccess: values reset to D2_WEBDAV_CONFIG_DEFAULTS; inputErrors cleared

markers: data-restore-focus='webdav-test-connection' on 测试网络连通性 button (test dialog close → focus returns)
data-restore-focus='webdav-save-config' on 保存配置 button (save dialog close → focus returns)
data-restore-focus='webdav-clear-config' on 清除配置 bottom action in webdav-error (clear dialog close → focus returns)
data-restore-focus on 4 webdav-error overlay link rows (check-account / check-password / check-permission / create-dir)
initialFocus: data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-test-cancel' on test dialog 取消 button (confirm state)
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-test-confirm' on test dialog 知道了 button (success state)
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-test-cancel' on test dialog 关闭 button (failed state)
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-save-cancel' on save dialog 取消 / 关闭 button
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-save-confirm' on save dialog 知道了 button (success state)
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-clear-cancel' on clear dialog 取消 / 关闭 button
data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-clear-confirm' on clear dialog 知道了 button (success state)

rendererFreeze.frozenGuard: render-runtime.js switch case throws Error for all 3 webdav routes; no fallback to legacy settingsScreen
rendererFreeze.legacyIsolation: legacy settingsScreen implementation remains in render-runtime.js but no longer serves any webdav route

r3aPreFunctionalVerification.stageDefinition: R3a = local admission verification: Phone + Tablet two-viewport automated tests + controlKey consistency + stable terminal state + 3 async flow tests + input validation + focus return evidence + a11y + console error = 0 + no compact-landscape/fold atoms + full regression no degradation
uiEventCatalog: route.push (1 view-remote-backup in webdav-test, 3 link rows in webdav-error)
stateOwnerCatalog: d2WebdavConfigState.values (persisted: serverUrl, account, password, syncDir, sslVerify, connectTimeout, wifiOnly, autoSync)

visualResultList.after: is-on class removed + aria-checked='false'; persisted to localStorage
visualResultList.terminalState: no aria-busy, no is-busy class, idempotent render

visualResultList.after: value updated; inputError cleared for that field; persisted to localStorage
aria-invalid='true' + aria-describedby='input-error-<settingsKey>'; <small role='alert'> with error message appears
visualResultList.clearOnNewInput: SET_INPUT for that field clears inputError; aria-invalid + aria-describedby removed

visualResultList.after: SELECT_AUTO_SYNC only accepts valid options (关闭/每小时/每天/手动); invalid rejected; persisted

visualResultList.loadingVisual: test dialog aria-busy='true'; confirm button disabled+aria-busy; text='测试中…'
visualResultList.successVisual: dialog shows success title; 知道了 button replaces confirm; data-dialog-initial-focus='webdav-test-confirm'
visualResultList.terminalState: no aria-busy after close; transient NOT persisted

visualResultList.failedVisual: test dialog aria-invalid='true'; confirm button aria-invalid + title=error + text='重试'; close button has data-dialog-initial-focus
visualResultList.terminalState: dialog still open; retry possible via executeTest()

visualResultList.loadingVisual: save dialog aria-busy='true'; button disabled+aria-busy; text='保存中…'
visualResultList.successVisual: dialog shows success title; 知道了 button replaces confirm
visualResultList.terminalState: no aria-busy after close; transient NOT persisted

visualResultList.loadingVisual: clear dialog aria-busy='true'; button disabled+aria-busy; text='清除中…'
visualResultList.successVisual: dialog shows success title; values reset to defaults; inputErrors cleared
visualResultList.terminalState: values reverted to D2_WEBDAV_CONFIG_DEFAULTS; persisted to localStorage

visualResultList.behavior: TEST_START / SAVE_START / CLEAR_START in non-confirm state returns same state reference; no duplicate dispatch
TEST_SUCCESS / TEST_FAILED / SAVE_* / CLEAR_* in non-loading state returns same state reference; stale results discarded
TEST_CONFIRM_OPEN / SAVE_CONFIRM_OPEN / CLEAR_CONFIRM_OPEN returns same state reference when another dialog is already open
visualResultList.terminalState: only one dialog open at a time

visualResultList.behavior: TEST_CONFIRM_CLOSE / SAVE_CONFIRM_CLOSE / CLEAR_CONFIRM_CLOSE returns same state reference when status === 'loading'

pageExceptions.exception: D2-C owned by webdavConfigV2 but uses static result page (no state owner). All 4 actions (back / webdav-test-again / webdav-save-config / webdav-view-remote-backup) have stable identity. Figma writer may render this as a static success page; no live state needed.

D2-C owned by webdavConfigV2 but uses static error page (no state owner). All 11 actions (back / 4 overlay link rows / 3 route link rows / 3 bottom actions) have stable identity. Figma writer may render this as a static error page; overlay dialogs for check-account/check-password/check-permission/create-dir are local-only hints, not full state flows.

figmaDecisionIssues.description: webdav-config has 4 inputs (serverUrl / account / password / syncDir) with icons + labels. Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing Settings/SettingRow input master, or (b) create a new WebDAV-specific input master. Local implementation reuses d2InputRow building block.

webdav-config has 3 confirm dialogs with title/description/2 buttons (confirm+cancel), and state variants (confirm/loading/success/failed). Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing fd-demo-dialog master with variants, or (b) create 3 new masters. Local implementation renders inline HTML with role='dialog' aria-modal='true'.

webdav-config uses d2Stepper for connect-timeout (minus/value/plus). Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing Primitive/Stepper master, or (b) create a new master. Local implementation reuses d2Stepper building block.

webdav-config uses native <article role='button' aria-haspopup='listbox'> pattern for autoSync. Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing Primitive/Select master, or (b) use native select. Local implementation uses custom <article> pattern matching other Settings rows.

webdav-config / webdav-test / webdav-error all use d2MetricGrid (4 metrics per page). Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing MetricGrid master, or (b) create a new master. Local implementation reuses d2MetricGrid building block.

figmaDecisionIssues.issue: WebDAV error page link row master
figmaDecisionIssues.description: webdav-error uses d2Row with link rows (4 overlay + 3 route). Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing Settings/LinkRow master, or (b) create a new WebDAV error row master. Local implementation reuses d2Row building block.

webdav-config renders a toast section at the bottom showing test/save status. Figma writer needs to decide: (a) use existing Toast/Banner master, or (b) create a new master. Local implementation renders inline HTML.
The 12-family classification (including webdav-config as family #2) is still 'recommended, pending user confirmation'. Figma writer must not proceed until user confirms the classification.

admission.r3aNote: R3a complete: 13/13 identity + 22/22 flow + 18/18 aria-focus = 53/53 webdav-config tests pass; 224/224 full regression tests pass (no degradation). Two-viewport Phone/Tablet controlKey set identical; renderer viewport-agnostic; no compact-landscape/fold atoms; stable terminal state verified for all flows; 3 async flows (test/save/clear) cover success/failed/duplicate-submit/stale-result/mutual-exclusion/loading-close-rejection; input validation covers required fields + URL prefix + clear-on-new-input + stepper clamp + select option validation; focus return markers verified on 3 overlay triggers + 4 webdav-error link rows; initial focus markers verified on cancel/confirm/close/知道了 buttons across confirm/success/failed states; accessible names non-empty; console error = 0.
admission.f1WriterAdmissionNote: LOCAL_READY_FOR_FIGMA = true. F1 writer admission is a separate Figma-side decision that requires: (1) user confirmation of 12-family classification, (2) Figma writer queue scheduling (F2 queue admitted after source-management), (3) Figma-side master decisions for the 8 issues listed in figmaDecisionIssues. Local side is unblocked.
